searchText: Is it possible to see how full or empty in terms of % the previous x number of blocks are currently? I would like to try and simulate BASEFEE price movements using that data `BLOCKHASH` gives you the hash of the last 256 blocks, you can prove `gasUsed` and `gasTarget` of the previous `x` blocks to see how full they are There isn't enough data available to simulate BASEFEE movements. You need end-user willingness to pay, which is a piece of data that we will not have until 1559 hits mainnet. So the tip counts towards the gas used? The `inclusion_fee_per_gas` is part of how much gas costs, not how much gas is used. You can use Dune analytics to look into past blocks Is this a serious issue? https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-1559-fee-market-change-for-eth-1-0-chain/2783/362 Haven’t had the time to read into it, but I believe the author wants to propose an addition / change to 1559 on the next ACD: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/294 I also pinged the author and asked them to come here to discuss it, otherwise it's extremely like that no one has the right context on the next ACD
